title: Forum accounts are being connected to Johnny.Decimal accounts
summary: Until now, your account on the forum has been separate from your main account. They're now the same.
content:
Until today, your forum account has been a completely separate account to your Johnny.Decimal account.

This was confusing. People wonder why they needed another account for the forum.

As of today, they're connected. When you log in at the forum, there's a button to do that With your Johnny.Decimal account.

Existing forum logins will stop working in a month.

There are more details in this pinned forum post. There's a bit of a migration process if your email addresses don't match, sorry. If you have any problems, post in that thread or email me.
